rounds.title: A very expensive refresh
rounds.context: Read this short news article. Who wrote it: AI or HUMAN?
rounds.body:
Bitcoin falls 50% after exchange dashboard repeats a decimal error

Bitcoin briefly appeared to lose half its value on Monday after a software update pushed the wrong reference price to several trading dashboards. The sudden drop triggered automated sell orders before operators corrected the feed.

Actual trading prices recovered within minutes, but screenshots of the plunge continued circulating. One exchange asked customers to stop refreshing the app while engineers restored the chart. Users who had spent the morning buying the dip were advised to check whether they had bought anything at all.
rounds.explanation: Original AI-written fictional news article for the game. The price-feed incident, exchange notice and purported sell orders are invented; this is not a report of a real Bitcoin event.
rounds.source: Original AI-written English news-style fiction, October 5, 2026. No genuine news outlet, publication date, quote or factual financial report is claimed. The narrative is fictional and does not describe a verified market movement.

rounds.title: The trophy before the ceremony
rounds.context: Read this short news article. Who wrote it: AI or HUMAN?
rounds.body:
Ballon d’Or result briefly appears in trophy delivery tracker

Kylian Mbappé’s name appeared as the recipient of a gold-plated trophy in a courier tracking page on Tuesday, prompting fans to claim the Ballon d’Or result had leaked ahead of the ceremony. The parcel was marked “signature required” and “do not leave with reception”.

Organisers said delivery records did not constitute an official announcement and that personalised trophies could be prepared for more than one finalist. The tracking link was removed within an hour, although the package continued to show the status “recipient not available”. Supporters immediately began debating whether this counted as another missed opportunity.
rounds.explanation: Original AI-written fictional sports-news article. The tracking-page leak, delivery status and organisers’ comment are invented; no real Ballon d’Or winner or leak is asserted.
rounds.source: Original AI-written English news-style fiction created for the quiz, October 5, 2026. Mbappé is a real public figure, but this delivery-tracker incident and all quoted phrases are invented. No real outlet or article is impersonated.
